<user_query>
In /root workspace, find the frontend codebase (likely lumiva-crm, pl1.lumiva-ui, or admin-ui) that contains:
1. Russian text "Блок на главной" or main page block editing modal
2. Project tasks UI with checklist, status dropdown, etc.

Search for these strings and file patterns (React/Vue components). Return: full paths to key files, framework used, and brief structure of how tasks and modals are built.
</user_query>
Searching the workspace for the Russian string and task-related UI patterns.

## Where this lives

Everything you asked about is in **`/root/lumiva-crm/frontend`**. Searches under **`/root/pl1.lumiva-ui`** and **`/root/admin-ui`** did not turn up the checklist / project-task patterns (no `checklist` hits in those trees for TS/TSX/Vue).

**Stack:** React 19 + TypeScript, **Vite**, **Tailwind CSS**, **react-router-dom**, **react-i18next** (`/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/package.json`).

---

### 1. Russian string «Блок на главной» and main-page block edit UI

| Role | Path |
|------|------|
| RU copy | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/locales/ru/translation.json` — key `crm.dashboard.widgets.editModalTitle` → `"Блок на главной"` (around line 1003) |
| Modal implementation | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx` — **inline** dialog (fixed overlay + `role="dialog"`), toggled by `widgetEditOpen` / `widgetEditId`; title uses `t('crm.dashboard.widgets.editModalTitle')` (around lines 1541–1599) |
| Opens the modal | Same file: `DashboardWidgetChrome` gets `onEdit={() => { setWidgetEditId(id); setWidgetEditTitle(widgetTitle(id)); setWidgetEditOpen(true); }}` (around 1388–1392) |
| Edit affordance on cards | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/dashboard/DashboardWidgetChrome.tsx` — pencil button calls `onEdit()`, labels from `crm.dashboard.widgets.editBlock` (around 122–148) |
| “Add block” flow (separate modal) | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/dashboard/DashboardAddPresetsModal.tsx`, rendered from `DashboardPage` when `presetsModalOpen` (around 1528–1538) |
| Layout / widget IDs / titles | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/dashboard/dashboardLayout.ts` (comments mention user titles for blocks on the home page) |

**Structure:** The home dashboard is one large page component. Widgets are wrapped in `DashboardWidgetChrome` (drag, resize, edit). The **rename/delete block** experience is **not** a separate modal component file; it is JSX inside `DashboardPage.tsx` plus i18n strings.

---

### 2. Project tasks UI (checklist, status dropdown, etc.)

| Role | Path |
|------|------|
| Types (`ProjectTask`, checklist items) | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/projects/projectTypes.ts` (`ProjectTaskChecklistItem`, `checklist: ...[]`; note in file that tasks/checklist/comments are front-end–centric) |
| **Full tasks tab** (new task row, **per-task status/priority `<select>`**, assignee popover with **checkboxes**, **checklist** with checkboxes + line items + remove) | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/projects/ProjectFormPage.tsx` — `tab === 'tasks'` block (roughly 1684–2047); handlers like `addChecklistItem`, `toggleChecklistDone`, `updateChecklistTitle` earlier in the same file (~1088+) |
| **Cross-project tasks** page (filters with status `<select>`, new task form with status/priority/date, **table** of tasks; new tasks use `checklist: []` — **no checklist sub-UI** in this page) | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/projects/ProjectTasksPage.tsx` |
| API mapping (includes `checklist`) | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/api/projects.ts` |
| List page | `/root/lumiva-crm/frontend/src/pages/projects/ProjectsListPage.tsx` — passes through `checklist` when saving tasks but is **not** where the checklist editor lives |

**Structure:** Tasks are modeled in `projectTypes.ts`. The **richest** UI (checklist + inline status/priority/deadline + assignees) lives in **`ProjectFormPage.tsx`** under the tasks tab: local React state drives updates, with native `<select>` for status/priority and small overlay panels for assignee checkboxes. **`ProjectTasksPage.tsx`** is a consolidated view with similar controls in a **table** layout but without the checklist editor. Persistence goes through `updateProject` / `fetchProject` in the projects API layer.

---

**Summary:** Use **`/root/lumiva-crm/frontend`** as the frontend app. «Блок на главной» is i18n + an inline modal on **`DashboardPage.tsx`**, triggered from **`DashboardWidgetChrome`**. Task checklist + status dropdowns are implemented mainly in **`ProjectFormPage.tsx`**; **`ProjectTasksPage.tsx`** covers multi-project task management with filters and table editing but not the full checklist UI.
